services.desc: A great beach trip gets even better when you are not trying to squeeze all your time on the water into one afternoon. At Indian Rocks Beach Boat Rental, our multi-day boat rental options are built for travelers who want more freedom during their stay. Whether you are planning family outings, fishing runs, sandbar stops, or relaxed sightseeing along the coast, having a boat for several days gives you room to enjoy it all at your own pace. Our family-owned team makes it easy to plan memorable time on the water with quality rentals, friendly service, and flexible options for vacationers staying in the area. blurb: Indian Rocks Beach Boat Rental offers a variety of boats including pontoon boats, fishing boats, and speed boats for different kinds of outings such as cruising, fishing, and active boating.
